estimand: increment of cached anomaly-map auxiliary branch within native Qwen

precision: entire frozen native Qwen BF16; PromptLearner/AdamW/cache maps FP32

initialization_audit.auxiliary_position: immediately after vision_end; official recomputed MRoPE

auxiliary_cache_check.scope: current branch official/manual exact same-shape parity
auxiliary_cache_check.gate_definition: finite, dtype-equal, exact same-shaped official/manual prefill, cached-step and full-replay logits and language inputs; exact positions/masks/cache lengths
auxiliary_cache_check.diagnostic_definition: official and manual cached-versus-full replay differences are diagnostic only; no numerical tolerance or argmax gate
auxiliary_cache_check.cached_step_scope: one next-token forward after the recorded prefill continuation token

official_cached_vs_official_full_replay.yes_no_score_scope: next-token candidate scores after the recorded forced/argmax replay token; not the image first-answer score

manual_cached_vs_manual_full_replay.yes_no_score_scope: next-token candidate scores after the recorded forced/argmax replay token; not the image first-answer score
